items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: Yeah, I've been playing with him on that day, you know, for the last seven years.

ctx.x: You say you've been working with Robichaud over there for... Harry Robichaud. Harry Robichaud. Is he the banjo player? Who? Harry Robichaud. Harry Robichaud, guitar player. Yeah, you know him? Yeah, I've heard him. I met him one time. Yeah. He's related to shots, wasn't he?
Yeah, I've been playing with him on that day, you know, for the last seven years.
